raw.query: SELECT n.run_id, n.numerator_worker_seconds, d.static_encoder_workers_effective, n.numerator_worker_seconds / (d.static_encoder_workers_effective * 483659.8) as cost_ratio FROM (SELECT run_id, provisioned_worker_seconds AS numerator_worker_seconds FROM provenance.encoder_run_summary WHERE run_id = 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_issuetime') n CROSS JOIN provenance.v_grid_static_effective d;
raw.evidence: aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_issuetime has provisioned worker seconds of 2,410,754.7 ws, deployable static fleet baseline (C=8 over 483,659.8s) is 3,869,278.4 ws, giving a cost ratio of 0.6231 (rounded to 0.62x).
